remarks: Westover Opportunity - Not to Be Missed! Here's the chance to use your designer energy & vision to create your dream home in Stamford's prized Westover community! This gracious, freshly painted 5-BR, 2.5B Colonial w/newer windows is privately set on parklike propty where it offers 3318sf of space in a wonderful floor plan designed for easy living & entertaining, indoors & out. Sunny well-proportioned rooms incl lg LR w/brick wall fireplace & picture window, that flows into a holiday-size DR-hdwd under carpets. Both DR & EIK access an expansive screened porch that embraces the back of the home for 3-season relaxing & dining while viewing the level usable lawn, mature trees & colorful plantings ... imagine the parties you can host! EIK has newer appliances incl French door refrigerator, double wall ovens, & Bosch dishwasher. Lg Family room w/beamed ceiling & built-ins is well-located off the roomy EIK ... PLUS there's a huge, versatile bonus room, just 2-steps down, perfect for a Great room, Playroom, Sunroom or Studio, the choice is yours! Upstairs you'll appreciate the newly uncovered rich hardwood flrs atop the stairs in the sizable landing hall & in each of the 5-BRs. Primary BR has 2-closets-one a walk-in + bath ensuite & large hall bathrm has double sinks. There's a roomy unfin basement, too. Here's a grand-sized home w/great bones, on gorgeous propty w/deep pvt front lawn, gracious entry & welcoming front porch, all at a Great Price! Your Westover opportunity awaits.
